description: This file defines the 'Theme' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installing, and uninstalling theme extensions, loading related models, handling permissions, and rendering views for theme management in the admin panel.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing theme extensions in the admin panel of OpenCart, including listing themes, and handling their installation and removal.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that renders the list of themes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves available themes, checks installed extensions, and prepares data to display in the theme management view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a theme extension, including permissions, autoload registration, and invoking optional install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of a theme extension, including permissions and optional uninstall scripts.
